name: Lex Mini IV 2024

venue.name: Lexington Public Library, Northside Library
venue.details: Morning: Medium Meeting Room; Afternoon: Large Meeting Room

information:
This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=kentucky&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Kentucky.

As space in the venue is limited, you may bring a maximum of one guest.

Lex Mini IV 2024 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org).
